name: AL.com / Alabama Media Group editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates AL.com Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate rating for its editorial board was found.

name: Alabama Reflector (voter guide, no endorsements)
lean_basis: Nonprofit newsroom that describes itself as 'an independent nonprofit website covering politics and policy in our state' (https://alabamareflector.com/about/) and does not endorse. No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.

name: League of Women Voters of Alabama (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that describes itself as 'a nonpartisan, grassroots organization working to protect and expand voting rights' (https://lwval.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Alabama Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; certified and supports its general-election nominees.

name: Alabama Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; certified and supports its general-election nominees.

name: Alabama Farmers Federation (FarmPAC)
lean_basis: Political arm of the Alabama Farmers Federation, a farm lobby that calls itself 'Alabama’s largest farm organization' (https://alfafarmers.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Business Council of Alabama (ProgressPAC)
lean_basis: PAC of the Business Council of Alabama, the state chamber, whose stated purpose 'is to improve the business climate statewide' (https://www.bcatoday.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Alabama Realtors PAC (ARPAC)
lean_basis: PAC of the Alabama Association of Realtors, a real estate trade group that calls itself 'the largest statewide organization of real estate professionals' (https://alabamarealtors.com/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Alabama AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation (AFL-CIO) that calls itself 'dedicated to represent the interests of working people at the state and local level' (https://unionhall.aflcio.org/alabama-afl-cio/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Alabama Education Association (A-VOTE)
lean_basis: Teachers' association that calls itself 'the member-driven voice of Alabama's education employees' (https://myaea.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Alabama Arise
lean_basis: Member-led advocacy group whose stated values include 'Racial, social, economic and environmental justice' (https://alarise.org/about/); it does not endorse candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Alabama Policy Institute
lean_basis: Self-described conservative think tank: it says it is committed to 'free markets, limited government, and strong families' and 'sets the standard for how to govern conservatively in the state of Alabama' (https://alabamapolicy.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
